text: Das Game hat zwei große redflags. Punkt eins ist, dass die maximal Länge einer Konzentrationssitzung 3h ist. Man wird praktisch gezwungen nach spätestens 3h auf das Handy zu sehen, um die Belohnung für die vergangenen 3h einzufordern um dann wiederum eine neue Sitzung zu starten. Das wiederspricht dem Grundgedanken der Abstinenz. Punkt zwei sind die Inappkäufe. Man kann die Situation der Konzentration für die Belohnungen damit umgehen. Das empfinde ich auch als stark kontraproduktiv.

text: Will playing games on your phone around the clock make you more productive? This app is all about getting you addicted so that you keep playing for little rewards. And watching ads. Which means little shots of dopamine. In effect they're training you to be addicted to the games in the app. If you think checking in on your character over and over throughout the day will help you get more done give it a try I guess. But a simple Pomodoro timer and natural movement breaks probably work better.

author: Thiago Tavares
developer_reply: Oi, obrigado por seu feedback. O Focus Quest usa a permissão de Acesso de Uso para verificar se você visitou outros aplicativos quando colocou o Focus Quest em segundo plano (ou saiu do Focus Quest). Se um aplicativo Pomodoro não usar essa permissão, o aplicativo precisa ser mantido aberto durante toda a sessão.
